method: Hand review of design/parity/evidence/<row>/comparison.png (reference, built, pixelmatch diff) against Material Design 3 component anatomy and the checked-in reference.

primitives.finding: Painted M3 rail with ten destinations, sublabels, theme toggle and lock; matches the reference anatomy.
Built bar shows the database title and KDBX metadata; the reference shows the destination title, a global search field and an Inspect action.
Material tab strip with pin partition, overflow and search; the fixture opens one database so pinned tabs and +N overflow are not exercised.
The legacy QStatusBar is hidden; entry count lives on the rail sublabel and progress reports through the notification host. Built height now equals the reference (repaired 2026-09-01).

The application draws its own 44 px Material title bar (mark, name, database, minimise/maximise/close) and the desktop caption is gone; the native frame, shadow and snap layouts remain. Whole-window proof: evidence/shell-default/window-frame.png (repaired 2026-09-01).
Surface containers, corner radii and outline variants resolve through the theme.

defects.summary: App bar shows database metadata instead of destination title, search and Inspect
